title: Rational Expressions: Simplify, Multiply, Divide, Add, and Subtract
seo_title: Rational Expressions Worksheet: Simplifying, Adding, Multiplying (Algebra 2) | 100 Questions
standard_text: Understand that rational expressions form a system analogous to the rational numbers, closed under addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division by a nonzero rational expression; add, subtract, multiply, and divide rational expressions.
meta_desc: Free Algebra 2 worksheet on rational expressions: simplifying and excluded values, multiplying, dividing, adding with an LCD and complex fractions. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Factor first, then cancel common factors, never single terms.
key_sub: To add, use the LCD. To divide, multiply by the reciprocal.
body_html:
How it works

A rational expression is a fraction with polynomials on the top and bottom. Work with them like number fractions, but factor first.

  • Simplify: factor the top and bottom, then cancel common factors (never single terms). The excluded values make the original denominator 0.
  • Multiply: factor, cancel, multiply across. Divide: multiply by the reciprocal.
  • Add or subtract: find the LCD, rewrite each fraction over it, then combine the numerators.
  • Complex fractions: multiply the top and bottom by the LCD of all the small fractions.
Example

Simplify (x² − 9) ÷ (x² + 5x + 6).

(x + 3)(x − 3) ÷ ((x + 2)(x + 3))

Answer: (x − 3)/(x + 2), x ≠ −3, −2

Example

Add 2/(x − 1) + 3/(x + 2).

LCD (x − 1)(x + 2)

2(x + 2) + 3(x − 1) = 5x + 1

Answer: (5x + 1)/((x − 1)(x + 2))

Common mistakes

  • Cancelling terms: (x + 3)/(x + 5) is not 3/5.
  • Forgetting an excluded value because its factor cancelled.
  • Adding the denominators. Rewrite over the LCD instead.
  • Not distributing the minus sign to every term of the second numerator.

faq.q: How do you simplify a rational expression?
faq.a: Factor the numerator and denominator completely, then cancel common factors. State the values that make the original denominator zero.

faq.q: How do you add rational expressions?
faq.a: Find the least common denominator, rewrite each fraction with it, add the numerators, and simplify.

faq.q: How do you divide rational expressions?
faq.a: Multiply the first expression by the reciprocal of the second, then factor and cancel.
A value of x that makes a denominator equal to zero. It is not allowed, even if the factor cancels later.

items.q: Simplify x² − 9x + 20x² − 3x − 10.
items.e: Factor: (x − 5)(x − 4)(x − 5)(x + 2). Cancel the common factor (x − 5): x − 4x + 2, with x ≠ 5, −2. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 9x + 18x² + x − 42?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 6)(x + 7). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 6) cancels with the numerator. x = −7 and x = 6.

items.q: Simplify x² + 6x + 8x² + x − 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x + 4)(x + 2)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x + 2): x + 4x − 1, with x ≠ −2, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² + 4x − 5x² − 25.
items.e: Factor: (x + 5)(x − 1)(x + 5)(x − 5). Cancel the common factor (x + 5): x − 1x − 5, with x ≠ −5, 5. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: Simplify x² − 6x + 5x² − 8x + 15.
items.e: Factor: (x − 5)(x − 1)(x − 5)(x − 3). Cancel the common factor (x − 5): x − 1x − 3, with x ≠ 5, 3. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 6x + 8x² − 2x − 8?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 4)(x + 2). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 4) cancels with the numerator. x = −2 and x = 4.

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 3x − 28x² + 5x + 4?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x + 4)(x + 1). It is 0 at both values, even though (x + 4) cancels with the numerator. x = −4 and x = −1.

items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 3)(x + 1). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 3) cancels with the numerator. x = −1 and x = 3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 12x + 35x² − 49.
items.e: Factor: (x − 7)(x − 5)(x − 7)(x + 7). Cancel the common factor (x − 7): x − 5x + 7, with x ≠ 7, −7. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.e: Factor: (x + 5)(x + 6)(x + 5)(x − 2). Cancel the common factor (x + 5): x + 6x − 2, with x ≠ −5, 2. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.e: Factor: (x + 1)(x + 2)(x + 1)(x − 1). Cancel the common factor (x + 1): x + 2x − 1, with x ≠ −1, 1. (You cannot cancel the x² terms.)

items.q: What values of x are excluded from the domain of x² − 6x + 5x² − 2x − 15?
items.e: Factor the denominator: (x − 5)(x + 3). It is 0 at both values, even though (x − 5) cancels with the numerator. x = −3 and x = 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − x − 12x − 7 ÷ x² + 2x − 24x − 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 4)(x + 3)x − 7 · x − 7(x − 4)(x + 6). Factor and cancel (x − 4) and (x − 7): x + 3x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² − 2x − 3x² − 10x + 24 · x − 4x + 1.
items.e: Factor: (x + 1)(x − 3)(x − 4)(x − 6) · x − 4x + 1. Cancel (x + 1) and (x − 4): x − 3x − 6.

items.q: Simplify x² − 49x² + x − 30 · x + 6x + 7.
items.e: Factor: (x + 7)(x − 7)(x + 6)(x − 5) · x + 6x + 7. Cancel (x + 7) and (x + 6): x − 7x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − 2x − 3x − 7 ÷ x² − x − 2x − 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 1)(x − 3)x − 7 · x − 7(x + 1)(x − 2). Factor and cancel (x + 1) and (x − 7): x − 3x − 2.

items.q: Simplify x² + 3x − 18x − 2 ÷ x² + x − 12x − 2.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 3)(x + 6)x − 2 · x − 2(x − 3)(x + 4). Factor and cancel (x − 3) and (x − 2): x + 6x + 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 4x² + 9x + 18 · x + 3x + 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x − 2)(x + 3)(x + 6) · x + 3x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x + 3): x − 2x + 6.

items.q: Simplify x² − x − 6x − 2 ÷ x² − 9x − 2.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 3)(x + 2)x − 2 · x − 2(x − 3)(x + 3). Factor and cancel (x − 3) and (x − 2): x + 2x + 3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 6x + 5x − 7 ÷ x² + 4x − 5x − 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 1)(x − 5)x − 7 · x − 7(x − 1)(x + 5). Factor and cancel (x − 1) and (x − 7): x − 5x + 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − x − 42x − 5 ÷ x² + 3x − 18x − 5.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 6)(x − 7)x − 5 · x − 5(x + 6)(x − 3). Factor and cancel (x + 6) and (x − 5): x − 7x − 3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 3x − 28x + 3 ÷ x² − 6x − 7x + 3.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 7)(x + 4)x + 3 · x + 3(x − 7)(x + 1). Factor and cancel (x − 7) and (x + 3): x + 4x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² + 6x + 8x² + 2x − 24 · x + 6x + 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x + 4)(x + 6)(x − 4) · x + 6x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x + 6): x + 4x − 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 7x + 6x² − x − 6 · x − 3x − 1.
items.e: Factor: (x − 1)(x − 6)(x − 3)(x + 2) · x − 3x − 1. Cancel (x − 1) and (x − 3): x − 6x + 2.

items.q: Simplify x² − 13x + 42x² − 4x + 3 · x − 3x − 7.
items.e: Factor: (x − 7)(x − 6)(x − 3)(x − 1) · x − 3x − 7. Cancel (x − 7) and (x − 3): x − 6x − 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 4x² + 4x + 3 · x + 1x + 2.
items.e: Factor: (x + 2)(x − 2)(x + 1)(x + 3) · x + 1x + 2. Cancel (x + 2) and (x + 1): x − 2x + 3.

items.q: Simplify x² − 9x + 18x² + x − 20 · x + 5x − 3.
items.e: Factor: (x − 3)(x − 6)(x + 5)(x − 4) · x + 5x − 3. Cancel (x − 3) and (x + 5): x − 6x − 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 3x − 28x + 2 ÷ x² − x − 20x + 2.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 4)(x − 7)x + 2 · x + 2(x + 4)(x − 5). Factor and cancel (x + 4) and (x + 2): x − 7x − 5.

items.q: Simplify x² − 25x + 7 ÷ x² − 4x − 5x + 7.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 5)(x + 5)x + 7 · x + 7(x − 5)(x + 1). Factor and cancel (x − 5) and (x + 7): x + 5x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 6x + 5x + 2 ÷ x² − 4x − 5x + 2.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 5)(x − 1)x + 2 · x + 2(x − 5)(x + 1). Factor and cancel (x − 5) and (x + 2): x − 1x + 1.

items.q: Simplify x² − 8x + 12x + 5 ÷ x² − 6x + 8x + 5.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x − 2)(x − 6)x + 5 · x + 5(x − 2)(x − 4). Factor and cancel (x − 2) and (x + 5): x − 6x − 4.

items.q: Simplify x² − 36x + 2 ÷ x² + x − 30x + 2.
items.e: Multiply by the reciprocal: (x + 6)(x − 6)x + 2 · x + 2(x + 6)(x − 5). Factor and cancel (x + 6) and (x + 2): x − 6x − 5.

items.q: Simplify 4x + 6 − 5x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x + 6)(x + 1). Rewrite: 4(x + 1)(x + 6)(x + 1) − 5(x + 6)(x + 6)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 1) − 5(x + 6) = −x − 26. −x − 26(x + 6)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 4x + 5 + 6x + 1.
items.e: LCD = (x + 5)(x + 1). Rewrite: 4(x + 1)(x + 5)(x + 1) + 6(x + 5)(x + 5)(x + 1). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 1) + 6(x + 5) = 10x + 34. 10x + 34(x + 5)(x + 1).

items.q: Simplify 4xx − 6 − 9xx − 6.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: −5xx − 6. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 5xx − 4 + 7xx − 4.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 12xx − 4. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 9xx − 4 − 2xx − 4.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 7xx − 4. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify xx − 5 + 5xx − 5.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 6xx − 5. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 5x − 6 − 4x + 3.
items.e: LCD = (x − 6)(x + 3). Rewrite: 5(x + 3)(x − 6)(x + 3) − 4(x − 6)(x − 6)(x + 3). Combine the numerators: 5(x + 3) − 4(x − 6) = x + 39. x + 39(x − 6)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify 4x + 1 − 1x − 2.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x − 2). Rewrite: 4(x − 2)(x + 1)(x − 2) − 1(x + 1)(x + 1)(x − 2). Combine the numerators: 4(x − 2) − 1(x + 1) = 3x − 9. 3x − 9(x + 1)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 1x − 5 − 5x + 3.
items.e: LCD = (x − 5)(x + 3). Rewrite: 1(x + 3)(x − 5)(x + 3) − 5(x − 5)(x − 5)(x + 3). Combine the numerators: 1(x + 3) − 5(x − 5) = −4x + 28. −4x + 28(x − 5)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify 3x + 1 − 6x + 3.
items.e: LCD = (x + 1)(x + 3). Rewrite: 3(x + 3)(x + 1)(x + 3) − 6(x + 1)(x + 1)(x + 3). Combine the numerators: 3(x + 3) − 6(x + 1) = −3x + 3. −3x + 3(x + 1)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify 3xx + 5 − 7xx + 5.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: −4xx + 5. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2xx + 5 − 7xx + 5.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: −5xx + 5. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 4xx + 6 + 2xx + 6.
items.e: The denominators match, so combine the numerators and keep the denominator: 6xx + 6. Never add the denominators.

items.q: Simplify 2x + 2 + 3x + 7.
items.e: LCD = (x + 2)(x + 7). Rewrite: 2(x + 7)(x + 2)(x + 7) + 3(x + 2)(x + 2)(x + 7). Combine the numerators: 2(x + 7) + 3(x + 2) = 5x + 20. 5x + 20(x + 2)(x + 7).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 2 − 6x − 4.
items.e: LCD = (x − 2)(x − 4). Rewrite: 4(x − 4)(x − 2)(x − 4) − 6(x − 2)(x − 2)(x − 4). Combine the numerators: 4(x − 4) − 6(x − 2) = −2x − 4. −2x − 4(x − 2)(x − 4).

items.q: Simplify 1x + 7 + 5x + 4.
items.e: LCD = (x + 7)(x + 4). Rewrite: 1(x + 4)(x + 7)(x + 4) + 5(x + 7)(x + 7)(x + 4). Combine the numerators: 1(x + 4) + 5(x + 7) = 6x + 39. 6x + 39(x + 7)(x + 4).

items.q: Simplify 1x + 3 + 4x − 7.
items.e: LCD = (x + 3)(x − 7). Rewrite: 1(x − 7)(x + 3)(x − 7) + 4(x + 3)(x + 3)(x − 7). Combine the numerators: 1(x − 7) + 4(x + 3) = 5x + 5. 5x + 5(x + 3)(x − 7).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 2 − 6x − 3.
items.e: LCD = (x − 2)(x − 3). Rewrite: 4(x − 3)(x − 2)(x − 3) − 6(x − 2)(x − 2)(x − 3). Combine the numerators: 4(x − 3) − 6(x − 2) = −2x. −2x(x − 2)(x − 3).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 1 + 2x − 2.
items.e: LCD = (x − 1)(x − 2). Rewrite: 4(x − 2)(x − 1)(x − 2) + 2(x − 1)(x − 1)(x − 2). Combine the numerators: 4(x − 2) + 2(x − 1) = 6x − 10. 6x − 10(x − 1)(x − 2).

items.q: Simplify 4x − 2 + 6x + 3.
items.e: LCD = (x − 2)(x + 3). Rewrite: 4(x + 3)(x − 2)(x + 3) + 6(x − 2)(x − 2)(x + 3). Combine the numerators: 4(x + 3) + 6(x − 2) = 10x. 10x(x − 2)(x + 3).

items.q: Simplify 1 + 4x1 − 16x².
items.e: Multiply the top and bottom by x²: x² + 4xx² − 16. The bottom is a difference of squares: x(x + 4) ÷ ((x + 4)(x − 4)) = xx − 4.

items.e: Multiply the top and bottom by x²: x² + 2xx² − 4. The bottom is a difference of squares: x(x + 2) ÷ ((x + 2)(x − 2)) = xx − 2.

items.q: Lucas drives 80 miles to a city at x mph and returns at x + 15 mph. Which expression gives the total driving time in hours?
items.e: Time = distance ÷ rate: 80x + 80x + 15. Use the LCD x(x + 15): 80(2x + 15)x(x + 15).

items.q: A group shares a $180 bus rental equally. With x people each pays $180x. If 2 more people join, how much less does each person pay?
items.e: 180x − 180x + 2 = 180(x + 2) − 180xx(x + 2) = 360x(x + 2) dollars.

items.q: One pump fills a tank in 2 hours and another in 6 hours. Working together, what fraction of the tank do they fill in one hour?
items.e: Add the rates: 12 + 16 = 23 of the tank per hour.

items.q: A rectangle has area x² + x − 12 and width x + 4. Which expression is its length?
items.e: Length = area ÷ width. Factor the area: (x + 4)(x − 3). Cancel (x + 4): x − 3.
